tool_sources.verifier_source:
from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
import json,hashlib,tarfile,os,shutil
O=Path.cwd()/'target/m2/stage38-candidate-seal-01';rd=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_bytes())
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with p.open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
 return h.hexdigest()
creation=rd(O/'creation.json');inventory=rd(O/'inventory.json');archive=Path(creation['archive']);assert sha(archive)==creation['archive_sha256'];assert sha(O/'inventory.json')==creation['inventory_sha256'];assert sha(O/'root-manifest.json')==creation['root_manifest_sha256'];assert sha(O/'closure-union-coverage.json')==creation['union_coverage_sha256'];scratch=O/'extracted';scratch.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
expected={p:v['sha256'] for p,v in inventory['files'].items()};expected.update({'seal/'+n:sha(O/n) for n in ['root-manifest.json','inventory.json','closure-union-coverage.json','seal.py']})
with tarfile.open(archive,'r:gz') as tar:
 members=tar.getmembers();names=[m.name for m in members];assert len(names)==len(set(names)) and set(names)==set(expected)
 for member in members:
  path=PurePosixPath(member.name);assert member.isfile() and not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
 tar.extractall(scratch,filter='data')
observed=set();verified_bytes=0
for directory,dirs,names in os.walk(scratch,topdown=True,followlinks=False):
 for name in dirs:assert not (Path(directory)/name).is_symlink()
 for name in names:
  p=Path(directory)/name;relative=p.relative_to(scratch).as_posix();assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink();assert relative in expected and sha(p)==expected[relative];observed.add(relative);verified_bytes+=p.stat().st_size
assert observed==set(expected)
# Re-read inventories independently: all old archived declarations and new
# declarations must have matching membership/hashes; no source path rewriting.
manifest=rd(scratch/'seal/root-manifest.json');union={};dependency_checks=[]
for name,dependency in manifest['dependencies'].items():
 ip=Path(dependency['inventory']);ap=Path(dependency['archive']);assert sha(ip)==dependency['inventory_sha256'] and sha(ap)==dependency['archive_sha256'];old=rd(ip)
 for entry in old['files'].values():assert entry['origin'] not in union;union[entry['origin']]=entry['sha256']
 dependency_checks.append(dict(name=name,inventory_sha256=sha(ip),archive_sha256=sha(ap),files=len(old['files'])))
for arc,entry in inventory['files'].items():assert entry['origin'] not in union;union[entry['origin']]=entry['sha256'];assert sha(Path(entry['origin']))==entry['sha256']
coverage=rd(scratch/'seal/closure-union-coverage.json');declared_total=0;closure_count=0
for row in coverage['roots']:
 if row['closure'] is None:continue
 p=Path(row['closure']);assert sha(p)==row['closure_sha256'];r=rd(p);items=r.get('files_sha256',r.get('files',{}));pairs=list(items.items()) if isinstance(items,dict) else [(x['path'],x) for x in items];checked=0
 for relative,value in pairs:
  expected_hash=value if isinstance(value,str) else value['sha256'];original=Path(relative)
  if not original.is_absolute():original=(p.parent.parents[2]/original) if original.parts[:2]==('target','m2') else p.parent/original
  assert union[str(original)]==expected_hash;checked+=1
 assert checked==row['declared_files']==row['covered_files'];assert not row['missing_files'];declared_total+=checked;closure_count+=1
assert len(coverage['repair_files'])==12 and coverage['passed'];assert archive.stat().st_size<=90*1024*1024
report=dict(passed=True,scope='Independent extraction/file-SHA and original-closure union verification; no evaluator execution, MAIN finalcheck or overall M2 completion claim.',archive_sha256=sha(archive),archive_bytes=archive.stat().st_size,payload_files=len(inventory['files']),extracted_files_verified=len(observed),extracted_bytes_verified=verified_bytes,original_input_files_stable=True,previous_dependencies_verified=dependency_checks,closed_original_manifests_verified=closure_count,declared_original_files_covered=declared_total,supplemental_repairs=12,duplicate_payload_origins=0,script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),generated_extraction_scratch_removed=True)
# This is a generated duplicate workspace only; preserve original inputs/tar.
shutil.rmtree(scratch);(O/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
